instruction: Matthew has sent me a message on phone regarding some amazon order. I am forgetting the details. Do as requested as per their last message.
notes: The task details are only in Matthew's latest text message, so the model uses placeholder objects (product-from-message, quantity-from-message, query-product-from-message) whose values are read at runtime. Flow: get passwords, log in to phone, find Matthew's contact (phone number + email), read his latest text, log in to amazon, search the requested product, add it to the cart with the requested quantity, look up the existing home address and a payment card, place the order, read the order total via show_order, log in to venmo and send Matthew a payment request for the total, then complete the task (no answer). If the message lists several products, add one product/quantity/query object per product and repeat amazon-search-products / amazon-add-product-to-cart before the single place_order. The order must go to the pre-existing home address (no address is added/changed) and exactly one payment request is created.
